title: [Decision] Does ruling 208 R6's dispatch-gates.mjs freeze still bind derivation-truth fixes? Two p2 cards (#24037, #24073) ask the derivation to stop telling devs CI runs what it will not run, while the same files took eight merges since the freeze
body:
Filing gate ② — a decision only the maintainer can make: whether a standing ruling still binds a class of work. Filed by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q`, marchtian) because two `pm:queue` cards in this lane cannot be dispatched or refused without it. Reader who acts: the maintainer (one letter), then this seat. Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack 「dispatch-gates frozen freeze ruling 208 R6 derivation」 (closed included) → no decision card on the freeze itself; #19491 / #19496 (closed) are the ruling and its charter PR; #23426 (closed, held under this freeze then landed as a devx rider) is the nearest precedent.

### 维护者速读

- **一句话问题：** `dispatch-gates.mjs` 给 dev 和席位算「该跑哪些门禁」。它现在会说「CI 会为你的路径跑 Dogfood Regression Gate」而 CI 在 PR 和合并队列上根本不跑它（#24073，main 因此红了一轮），也会漏算一个确实会在 CI 跑的门禁（#24037，本地 98/98 对账全绿而 CI 红）。修这两处都要改 `dispatch-gates.mjs`，而裁决 208 R6 把这个文件**冻结**了（「只在它喂的 workflow 坏了时碰」）。同一文件自冻结以来却已被 8 个合并改过，其中至少 2 个就是同类的「推导漏算」修复。
- **选项：**
  - **A** 字面冻结：两张卡 not planned，以后同类卡同样关；CI 仍兜底。
  - **B**（推荐）收窄冻结：允许「让推导说真话」的修复 —— 推导输出要与 CI 实际跑的一致，含从现有门禁自己的扫描根推导它；⛔ 不新增门禁、不新增行、不新增棘轮、不动 `--tier` 档位表与常量。把这一句写进 `instrument-discipline.md`。
  - **C** 解冻：`dispatch-gates.mjs` 回到普通 `scripts/pm/**` 文件。
- **推荐 B**，备选 A。
- **请回：** `A / B / C`。

### Governing text

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md` L10: 「工具位只有一个,先花在删除上;`dispatch-gates.mjs` 冻结,只在它喂的 workflow 坏了时碰。」 and L11–12: provenance = ruling 208, card #19491, comment 5755284987 (R6: 「`dispatch-gates.mjs` kept frozen (#19496)」).
- AGENTS.md 「Route & surface ownership」 rule 3 「Absence must be loud … a verifier that silently degrades (reusing a stale build, skipping a check it could not run) is worse than no verifier, because it reports success」 and rule 4 「Machine-readable surfaces must not lie」.
- SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉: 「新增门禁默认否」; 「具名不升级类(立即行动):恢复不变量」 — the question here is whether derivation truth is 「恢复不变量」 under a file-level freeze, which only the ruling's author can say.

### Premises, each with a re-check

- `git show origin/main:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md | grep -c "冻结"` → 1 (control: `grep -c "工具位"` → 1).
- `git log origin/main --oneline -- scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs | head -12` → 12 touches since 2026-09-27, 8 of them after the freeze (2026-10-08 … 2026-10-16), including `9a6f790a3` 「dispatch-gates names check:durability-log-level …」 (the fix for #23584) and `5ff7cbe36` 「dispatch-gates names check:error-status-conformance …」 (the fix for #22320). Control: `git log origin/main --oneline -- scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs | head -3` → hits.
- #24037 (open, `pm:queue`, p2) and #24073 (open, `pm:queue`, p2) both name `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` as the file to change; neither adds a gate. Re-check: `gh api /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24037 --jq '.state'` → open.
- The two cards' measured costs: #24073 — `main` `Dogfood Regression Gate` red from `9e797a8976` (#24009) to `8133cc7805` (#24069); #24037 — PR #24028's local `--ran` 98/98 while CI's `Lint · repo & tooling gates` went red.

### Options

| Option | What changes | What a dev or seat sees | Effort |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** literal freeze | Nothing in the tool. #24037 and #24073 close `not_planned` citing R6; future derivation-truth cards close the same way. | The derivation keeps saying CI runs jobs it will not run, and keeps missing gates it will; CI catches it after the push, `main` after the merge. | 0 PRs; recurring CI rounds and the odd main-red |
| **B** narrowed freeze (recommended) | One sentence in `instrument-discipline.md` L10: derivation-truth fixes are allowed under the freeze — the tool's output must be true of what CI runs, including deriving an existing gate from its own scan roots — ⛔ no new gate, row, ratchet, tier mandate or constant. Then #24037 and #24073 dispatch as ordinary `domain:skills` M cards. | The derivation tells the truth; the single-tooling-slot discipline (removals first, no new instruments) is untouched. | 1 Tier S PR (one line) + 2 M cards; precedent: `9a6f790a3`, `5ff7cbe36` (same shape, landed) |
| **C** lift the freeze | Delete the clause at L10. | `dispatch-gates.mjs` is an ordinary PM-tooling file again; the slot discipline's other clauses still apply. | 1 Tier S PR; re-opens the expansion the freeze was written against |

### Four-axis analysis

- **Long-term fit (leads):** an instrument that reports completeness it does not have is the failure AGENTS.md's rule 3 names — worse than no instrument. The freeze was written to stop the tool growing (R6's whole sentence is about the single tooling slot going to removals first); keeping an existing instrument truthful is maintenance of an invariant, not growth. B keeps both: truth and the no-growth rule. A keeps the text and loses the truth. C loses the no-growth rule.
- **Business pull:** measured twice this week — a main-red (#24073) and a false-complete local record (#24037) — and three times before (#22320, #23584, #21011), each closed per instance by exactly the kind of fix B allows.
- **AI-proofing:** a dev reads 「scheduled BY YOUR PATHS」 and `--ran` 98/98 as proof; a false proof trains every later dev and seat to trust it. Under B the tool's statement and CI's run agree, so a green reads as green. Under A the seat must carry a standing note 「the derivation lies about X」 — the kind of tribal knowledge the fleet cannot keep.
- **Startup focus:** B adds no gate, no row, no ratchet; it writes one sentence and lets two p2 cards proceed. A costs recurring CI rounds. C re-opens the door R6 closed.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：B 守住「仪器不说谎」与「工具位只减不增」两条；A 守文字丢真话；C 丢掉不增的纪律。
- ② 实际业务拉动：本周两次实测（一次 main 红、一次本地假完整），此前三张同族卡各自以同形修复落地。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：假「完整」会被 dev 与席位当证据；B 让工具陈述与 CI 实跑一致，绿才是绿。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：B 不加门禁不加行不加棘轮，一句话放行两张 p2；A 反复付 CI 轮次；C 重开 R6 关上的门。
Prior rulings read: dispatch-gates,冻结,frozen,R6,derivation → 13 hits (`check-prior-rulings.mjs --terms`; the ADR sections it names — ADR-0018 §2, ADR-0035 §3/§6, ADR-0059 §3/§4, ADR-0085 §3 — are code anchors on 「derivation」 in spec, not this freeze); ruling 208 R6 (#19491, 5755284987) is the governing ruling; thread: none (new card)

**Recommendation: B.** Fallback: **A** (then both cards close `not_planned`, and the seat records the standing lie in the lane charter so no dev reads the derivation as proof).
**Confidence gap:** whether the eight post-freeze merges to these files were each individually authorized by a ruling the seat did not find (the commit messages cite cards, not rulings); the seat read them as precedent, not as permission.

### After the ruling

- **B:** one `domain:skills` card (or this one, re-labelled `pm:queue`) edits `instrument-discipline.md` L10 (Tier S); #24037 and #24073 leave `pm:blocked` for `pm:queue` in the same act and dispatch at `TIER_DEFAULT` with the ratchet and self-test battery of `dispatch-gates` as their gates.
- **A:** #24037 and #24073 close `not_planned` with the letter quoted; the lane charter gains the standing note.
- **C:** the clause is deleted (Tier S); the two cards proceed as in B.

Blocked on this card: #24037, #24073 (`pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by:` lines on each).
